card.text: Explore Lucina in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by Keck adaptive-optics images. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 1837 shape model
shape.summary: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by Keck adaptive-optics images. Selected archive volume-equivalent diameter: 154 ±15 km. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 1837 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 77 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
